basic_details.short_information: Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU) will hold walk-in interviews on 12 November 2026 (Management at 9:30 a.m., Social Work at 12.30 p.m.) and 13 November 2026 (Education for B.Ed. Course at 9:30 a.m.). The venue is the Committee Room, University Guest House, MANUU Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad - 500 032 (TS). The University is engaging 5 Assistant Professors (contractual) on a short-term, purely temporary basis for its Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE), with a salary not exceeding Rs. 50,000 per month as per UGC norms.

age_limit.details: The notice does not mention a general age limit. Retired teachers (Professors/Associate Professors/Assistant Professors) from Government recognized Institutions below 65 years are also eligible for any of the above disciplines.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: MBA/PGDBM or relevant allied discipline with 60 percent marks, plus Ph.D./NET (Management)
Master's degree with 55% marks plus NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D., or a top-500 foreign Ph.D. (details below)
Postgraduate degrees with 55% marks plus NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D., or a top-500 foreign Ph.D. (details below)

qualification.details: Total: 5 posts. The notice states that reservation categories are as per Government of India rules, but it does not print a category-wise break-up. | Essential: "Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA)/PGDBM or a relevant allied discipline with the minimum of 60 percent marks." The candidate must fulfil Ph.D./NET (Management) qualification, in accordance with the relevant UGC/AICTE regulations and amendments. Desirable: Technology-savvy and proficient in the use of digital teaching tools, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and AI-enabled applications including Generative AI, for teaching, learning and academic content development. | A (i): A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. A (ii): Besides this, the candidate must have cleared NET conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET. Candidates who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. in accordance with the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments are exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Note: NET/SLET/SET is also not required for Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or a similar accredited test. OR B: A Ph.D. obtained from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by QS, the Times Higher Education (THE) or the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Desirable: the same technology and digital teaching skills listed for Management. | A (i): Postgraduate degree (viz. Pedagogy of Physical Science and Mathematics) with minimum 55% marks in the discipline relevant to the area of specialization. A (ii): Postgraduate degree in Education (M.Ed/M.A. Education) with minimum 55% marks. A (iii): Besides these, the candidate must have cleared NET conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar UGC-accredited test like SLET/SET. Candidates awarded a Ph.D. in accordance with the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments are exempted from NET/SLET/SET. OR B: A Ph.D. obtained from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by QS, THE or ARWU (Shanghai Jiao Tong University). Preferable: Pedagogy of Physical Science and Mathematics. Desirable: the same technology and digital teaching skills listed for Management. | For Social Work and Education, candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009 are governed by the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the awarding institution. They are exempted from NET/SLET/SET, subject to all of these conditions: | The fulfilment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned. | Urdu is compulsory for all teaching posts as a general policy. The candidate should either be from an Urdu medium School/Madarsa, or should have studied Urdu as a subject at X Std., +2/Intermediate or UG level. Alternatively, the candidate may have studied Urdu as one of the subjects at X or XII from Central or State Boards recognized by the Govt. of India, Madrasa Boards of State Government, or NIOS/State Open Schools recognized by the Govt. of India (Ministry of HRD). UG/PG (Urdu), or Urdu as one of the subjects from any UGC recognized State/Central/Private University, is also accepted. | As per Clause 3.3(I) of the UGC Regulations, 2018, NET or an accredited test (SLET/SET) remains the minimum eligibility for appointment of Assistant Professor wherever provided in those Regulations. SLET/SET is valid as the minimum eligibility for direct recruitment only to Universities/Colleges/Institutions in the respective state. The UGC Gazette Notification dated 31 July 2023 also states that a SLET/SET score is valid only for appointment in respective State Universities/Colleges/Institutions. | The notice does not mention a general age limit. Retired teachers (Professors/Associate Professors/Assistant Professors) from Government recognized Institutions below 65 years are also eligible for any of the above disciplines. | The monthly remuneration is a salary not exceeding 50,000/- per month as per UGC norms. The engagement is contractual, on a short-term basis and purely temporary. Selected candidates shall be liable to be posted at MANUU Headquarters at Hyderabad or any of the Institutions of the University in the country, depending on the requirements and exigencies of service. | See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: About MANUU

These posts are for the Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE) at the MANUU Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad. The notice refers to the MANUU Headquarters at Hyderabad and other Institutions of the University in the country.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Resume Original educational certificates Original experience certificates Proof of Knowledge of Urdu Testimonials Passport size photograph One set of attested photocopies of the above, for verification The Registration Form printed at the end of the notice. It asks for the post and subject, name, father's name, date of birth/age, category, graduation, post-graduation, Ph.D. and NET details, proof of Urdu qualification, other qualifications, whether you are pursuing a regular course such as M.Phil/Ph.D., teaching experience, addresses, mobile number, email, PAN and Aadhaar numbers. Paste a recent passport size photograph duly signed by the applicant on the form and sign the declaration. Candidates attend the interview at their own expenses.

faq.question: Q1. When is the MANUU Assistant Professor walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Management and Social Work interviews are on 12 November 2026, and Education (For B.Ed. Course) is on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Report at 9:30 a.m. for Management and Education, or at 12.30 p.m. for Social Work, at the Committee Room, University Guest House, MANUU Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad - 500 032 (TS).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 5 tentative posts: 02 in Management, 01 in Social Work and 02 in Education (For B.Ed. Course).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Management?
faq.answer: An MBA/PGDBM or relevant allied discipline with minimum 60 percent marks is required, plus Ph.D./NET (Management) as per relevant UGC/AICTE regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The salary is not exceeding 50,000/- per month as per UGC norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is knowledge of Urdu compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. Urdu is compulsory for all teaching posts, shown by Urdu medium schooling or by studying Urdu at X, XII, UG or PG level as the notice specifies.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring your resume, original educational and experience certificates, proof of Knowledge of Urdu, testimonials, a passport size photograph and one set of attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Can retired teachers attend?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors from Government recognized Institutions below 65 years are eligible for any of the disciplines.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is contractual on a short-term basis, purely temporary, at the Centre for Distance and Online Education.

faq.question: Q10. Is a SLET/SET valid for this post?
faq.answer: As per the UGC rules quoted in the notice, SLET/SET is valid only for appointment in institutions of the respective state.
